metadata.method: 1D classical RCWA, continuous Fourier integrals, inverse-rule factorization, TMM
metadata.geometry: Centered exact-boundary rectangle; invariant y; one computational slab
metadata.angle_convention: degrees from +z surface normal; incidence in x-z plane
metadata.material_convention: Public n+i*k for exp(-i*omega*t); conjugated for meent finite-layer matrices and explicit outgoing port admittances
metadata.port_adapter: Corrected complex-port initialization: kz=conj(sqrt(N^2-kx^2)), TM admittance kz/conj(N)^2; upstream meent RCWA eigensolve/cascade/power unchanged
metadata.polarization_convention: s: electric field along y; p: magnetic field along y; power only
metadata.power_normalization: Unit incident normal Poynting flux; R at z=0, T at z=thickness into semi-infinite substrate (entrance-plane flux, including lossy ports)
metadata.material_interpolation: Linear n and k separately; extrapolation forbidden
metadata.regularization: none; no damping, pseudoinverse, angular perturbation, or output clipping

warnings: Fourier convergence is not certified by a single run. Refine harmonics for your sample.
